UserPromptSubmit.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); MSG=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"message\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$MSG" | grep -qiE "add.?task|create.?task|new.?task|capture|task.?add"; then echo "[TASK] Task creation detected. Consider /add-task for guided creation."; elif echo "$MSG" | grep -qiE "list.?tasks?|show.?my.?tasks|what.?s.?open|filter.?tasks|tasks?.?by.?priority"; then echo "[TASK] Task query detected. Consider /list-tasks or /task-dashboard."; elif echo "$MSG" | grep -qiE "mark.?done|complete.?task|finish.?task|close.?task"; then echo "[TASK] Task completion detected. Consider /complete-task."; elif echo "$MSG" | grep -qiE "sync.?github|push.?to.?issues|github.?issue"; then echo "[TASK] GitHub sync detected. Consider /sync-github."; elif echo "$MSG" | grep -qiE "add.?backend|create.?backend|storage.?backend"; then echo "[TASK] Backend creation detected. Use /add-backend to spawn backend-architect."; elif echo "$MSG" | grep -qiE "create.?plugin|add.?plugin|write.?hook.?plugin|new.?integration"; then echo "[TASK] Plugin creation detected. Use /add-plugin to spawn plugin-architect."; elif echo "$MSG" | grep -qiE "run.?checks|verify|lint.?and.?test|pre.?commit"; then echo "[TASK] Quality check detected. Consider /run-checks."; elif echo "$MSG" | grep -qiE "dashboard|triage|daily.?review|what.?should.?I.?work"; then echo "[TASK] Dashboard request detected. Consider /task-dashboard."; fi'

PostToolUseFailure.command: bash -c 'INPUT=$(cat); TOOL=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_name\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); [ -z "$TOOL" ] && TOOL="$HOOK_TOOL_NAME"; OUTPUT=$(echo "$INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; print(json.load(sys.stdin).get(\"tool_output\",\"\"))" 2>/dev/null); if [ "$TOOL" = "Bash" ] && echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -qiE "FAILED|ERROR|failures"; then echo "[TEST FAILURE] Detected test failure. Check the most recently edited file. Failing output:"; echo "$OUTPUT" | grep -E "FAILED|AssertionError|ERROR" | head -5; fi'

Stop.command: echo '[SESSION END] Check if any new patterns were discovered (import violations, test failures, convention breaks). Update relevant feedback memory files in .claude/memory/ if needed.'
